prototypes.method: fast-check configureGlobal reporter in a Vitest setup module
prototypes.interpretation: The setup and application imports did not share observable global reporter state under Vitest module isolation.

prototypes.method: Vitest module mock wrapping fast-check assert
prototypes.interpretation: The setup-time mock did not intercept the application's already-resolved fast-check import.

prototypes.method: direct mutation of the imported fast-check assert export
prototypes.interpretation: The ESM export is read-only and rejected mutation before test collection.

prototypes.method: adapter-owned global setup teardown requiring a strict report
prototypes.diagnostic: sampling observer did not emit strict JSON
prototypes.interpretation: The final prototype fails closed even when the nested property and outer Vitest node pass.

decision.reason: Documented runner setup and fast-check reporter APIs do not guarantee interception of the application's framework instance under Vitest isolation. An observer that is not structurally in the property call path cannot author evidence.
